Maresca's Turning Point: Grinding Out Results Under Pressure

For Chelsea, playing attractive, high-possession football has been the hallmark of Maresca's early tenure. However, as the Premier League table tightens and the schedule congests, the ability to win ugly has become paramount. Maresca highlighted the character of his squad after securing a hard-fought three points that keeps them firmly in the Champions League qualification spots.

"We need this kind of win in every way. It is not always about playing beautiful football; it is about resilience, suffering together, and showing the mentality required to compete at the very top of the Premier League." — Enzo Maresca

The result adds immense pressure to their direct rivals, with the upcoming EPL fixtures presenting a make-or-break period for clubs hovering around the top four, including Manchester City, Arsenal, and Aston Villa.
